title: Playlist error states share one classifier and one caution alert
acceptance: classifyPlaylistDrillInError (and classifyProviderLibraryError) live in apps/web/src/lib/music-library.ts, imported by TrackSearch and Dashboard.

One caution alert component renders forbidden, quota and reauth playlist errors in the builder drill-in, the builder playlist index and the Music tab PlaylistBrowserDialog, with the same glyph and styling.
Dashboard RF-74 tests build ApiError failures without reparenting the mocked ApiError prototype.
Optional, owner call: Manage connections from the playlist dialog keeps the chosen template and playlist after reconnecting.
nextAction: Non-blocking findings from the #764 final review (2026-11-13), cleanup only. Propose the shared helper and component, then implement with the existing RF-74 tests as the regression net.

evidence.summary: Final review (/code-review medium) on 443c477a: no significant findings; five cleanup findings (classifier in a component file, duplicated caution markup, inconsistent index quota styling, prototype-mutating test helper, reconnect path drops dialog state).
